verdicts.reason: Both candidates are essentially the same proportional shrink, not a rearrangement. In each, the decorative circles are now oversized for the canvas. The right circle runs up behind the end of the quote and the attribution, and the left circle sits behind the start of the quote, so there are no clean background zones left. The SOLSTICE logo wordmark in the bottom-left corner and the label on the product can are too small to read, and the attribution line is borderline. A's wordmark is very slightly larger, but the two are practically identical.
